title: Upload fails with apparent storage timeout
incident_description: The stack trace ends in storage, but malformed retry configuration causes a zero-second deadline.
logs: StorageTimeout at client.put_object; network dashboard healthy
ground_truth: A string-to-integer configuration conversion truncates a fractional upload timeout to zero, causing an immediate local timeout
recommended_fix: Parse fractional timeout as float, validate it is positive, and add configuration boundary tests.
alternatives: The object storage service is timing out
